findings.title: Completion logs no longer include the trace ID
findings.body: This log call now relies on `FromContext` for its fields, but the new contextual-logger middleware adds endpoint, plugin, datasource, and username attributes only. The previous implementation explicitly added `traceID` from the tracing context to the completion log. As a result, backend plugin request logs lose trace correlation, making these requests harder to diagnose.

findings.title: Context-derived test logger discards recorded calls
findings.body: `FromContext` returns a fresh `TestLogger`, whose log calls are recorded on that new instance rather than the original fake. Since `LoggerMiddleware` now logs through `FromContext`, tests that inspect the original `TestLogger` will see no calls, so the fake cannot reliably verify this logging behavior.
